children.content: A · Right header: one state at a time

children.name: Screen note
children.content: A new 40pt row at the top of the right column, above the Change stream / Terminals tabs. Left: the PR number chip (opens the PR on GitHub) and where things stand. Right: the one next step. Buttons that hand work to the agent send a short message with the instructions attached as a chip (screen B). Merge, Continue and Archive run directly, no agent.

chatMessages.name: Screen · B · Chat shows the instructions as a chip

children.name: Screen title
children.content: B · Chat: the message is short, the instructions ride along as a chip

children.name: Screen note
children.content: The button writes the instructions to ~/Library/Application Support/Slipstream/attachments/<id>/<name>.md (outside the worktree, so it never shows as a change) and sends the agent one line ending in an @⟦name⟧(path) marker. The chat draws the marker as a chip; clicking it opens the file. The chip survives reopening the chat because the marker is part of the message text. Commit and push and Resolve conflicts have no file, so they're plain messages.
